user.title: Add a Flexit Roomie fan
user.description: Give the fan a fixed IP address (a DHCP reservation in your router) first, so it does not change later.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, for example the room the fan is in.
data_description.ip_address: The address of the fan on your local network.
data_description.port: Leave this at 4000 unless you have changed it on the fan.

error.cannot_connect: The fan did not answer. Check the IP address, that Home Assistant is on the same network, and that this is a v1 unit (newer v2 units are not supported).

abort.already_configured: This fan is already set up.
